newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade very slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade very slow - USDA.

text.p: Trade at a near standstill in the Panhandle area Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested, USDA said. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.

109,200 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 32,300 formulated and 2,500 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week. The last established price was 66.00 on Tuesday. Today's packer bids are 65.00-66.00 with asking prices 66.00- 67.00.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 1-3 1200-1250 lb Holsteins 59.50.
Note all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Wk to Date: 109,200 Last Week: 116,300 Year Ago: 68,800
